source.name: Saudi Post | SPL – SPL Becomes Al-Diriyah Club's Logistics Partner
source.quote: SPL and Al-Diriyah Sports Club Company, a subsidiary of Diriyah Company, have signed a three-season partnership agreement
source.note: Club's own news page (diriyahclub.sa/en) carries the same announcement, titled 'SPL, Official Logistics Partner of Diriyah Club'. No shirt placement stated; recorded as a partner deal.

note: Signed 18 Aug 2026, described as running over the next three seasons; no deal value published.
